subject: Kickoff: CANN visual localization core
body:
Hi Daniela, Nikhil,

Kickoff for the CANN effort in vision. Our ICCV work on Constrained Approximate Nearest Neighbors is a genuinely strong wedge for indoor visual positioning - malls, airports, warehouses - where GPS dies. Two properties matter commercially: the retrieval scheme is independent of the local feature type (any d-dimensional vectors, so customers aren't locked to our extractor), and the reference results on Baidu-Mall are already competitive.

Window Apr 13 - Jul 6. M1 (May 8): repro of the released end-to-end run.sh index/query flow on the sample data (FIRE features), then the Baidu-Mall benchmark. M2 (Jun 5): scale test - index a 10x larger internal capture set, measure recall/latency curves. M3 (Jun 29): integration proposal for the vision serving stack + go/no-go on a pilot with the logistics customer.

Nikhil is TL (25%, he's still wrapping Vantage follow-ups; Linnea carries the build). Daniela owns staffing.

Lucia
